content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to transfer the result from a mathematical instruction (B020) to a counter block (B012). While testing in simulation mode, the value calculated in B020 is correctly sent to B012. However, this does not work on the actual PLC hardware. Any suggestions would be helpful.

Why do you believe the value generated by B020 isn't being used as the OFF parameter for B012 on the physical [product_name]? Is it because, as shown in the attached image, the parameter field displays 0? Note that values in this field are intended for offline or simulation viewing only and do not represent live online values.

You're correct, I cannot monitor live values in online test mode, but the real values seem to match what was seen in simulation mode. After testing on-site, the B012 counter resets at 10 pulses in I3 as expected. I assumed something was wrong due to the behavior observed in online mode. Thanks!

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered confusion regarding how reference values between blocks are viewed in real-time and simulation modes with [product_name]. The main issue was misunderstanding differences between simulated and live display interfaces, leading to incorrect assumptions about actual operation. The functionality in the real environment was confirmed to work as intended after field testing.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipated that real-time monitoring in online mode would provide the same value feedback and parameter referencing as observed in simulation and offline modes.
